notes:
SEC1-4-R2: Maintainer risk: medium — Two new P2 logic errors introduced by round-1 optimization refactor: (1) invite uses counter not rolled back on TOCTOU race loss in Space/join (JMAP-avb.1); (2) has_direct_create pre-fetch guard bypassable with non-lowercase kind string, silently disabling duplicate-chat detection (JMAP-avb.2). One P3 doc/API confusion in ClosureHandler BackendCallFn signature (JMAP-avb.3). No new P0/P1 introduced. All issues are contained within crate-jmap-chat-server. Round-1 fixes to SetError merge and generic handler delegation are clean.
SEC7-R2 confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Running out of real complaints: yes. Reason: Round-2 agents filed 2 issues (JMAP-avb.1, JMAP-avb.2). JMAP-avb.1 (Space/join invite uses not rolled back on TOCTOU race loss) is a confirmed P2 correctness bug — the uses increment at line 667 is not reversed on the race-loss path at line 732-738. JMAP-avb.2 (Chat/set kind case sensitivity) is rated P3 not P2: a client sending 'Direct' (wrong case) produces ChatKind::Other('Direct') which is a malformed object, not a duplicate Direct chat — the pre-check is not bypassed, it is simply not reached because has_direct_create is false; the net effect is the client gets a wrongly-typed chat rather than a duplicate, which is a protocol-error-handling gap, not a security/correctness bypass. Opinion labels applied this round: JMAP-63k.7 (variable name abbreviations), JMAP-63k.14 (intermediate boolean naming), JMAP-63k.16 (comment quality on cast). Round-1 issues verified: none of JMAP-63k.2/.5/.7/.10/.11/.14/.15/.16 are P1/P2 in disguise. 63k.2 (redundant scan) and 63k.5 (DRY violation) retain engineering basis and no opinion label. Residual risk: Space/join TOCTOU is now tracked. No further P1/P2 candidates visible across all reviewed files. Recommend stopping review rounds.
SEC0-R2: one new correctness bug found and filed as JMAP-avb.4 (space.rs TOCTOU dedup removes wrong member entry). All round-1 fixes verified correct: chat.rs dedup (JMAP-63k.17/19/23), handle_chat_get/query_changes delegation, backend.rs SetError merge, submission.rs+helpers.rs find_immutable_patch_key move, space.rs TOCTOU guard structure. No regressions detected in the round-1 changes.
